method: Static source scan of homepage, preserved feature map, patient education content, research sources, calculators, booking intake, article reader, payments, contact actions and sitemap. Inventory baseline only; URLs were not live-tested. Manual reconciliation after the first automated check: root-only Google Fonts preconnects are not navigable links; the Make webhook URL is a UI placeholder, not a configured destination; a dead Norton scale reference was replaced by AHRQ; and the visible CRS Form 4/4A link was switched to the verified full official forms PDF.
verification_policy: No destination is marked verified unless an actual HTTP/link test was executed. Dynamic templates, placeholders, provider-dependent routes and phone/WhatsApp handoffs require separate tests.
